tools.name: who-is-trafford
tools.description: Returns the published account of what Trafford Crump's team is building, and his role on it.

tools.name: experience-and-skills
tools.description: Returns the published topics and the live profile links, including Google Scholar, ORCID, the UCalgary profile, and O3R.

tools.name: collaboration-fit
tools.description: Returns the work and collaborations described in the public record. Preferences that are not stated there are reported as not stated.

tools.name: collaboration-request
tools.description: Classifies a collaboration request against the published record. Returns reject, accept, or uncertain. An acceptance includes the booking page. An uncertain request is flagged for review.
